answer_1.quote: We develop (1) the first multimodal entailment tree generator, TV-TREES (the Transparent Video-Text REasoning with Entailment System), and (2) the task of multimodal entailment tree generation...

methods: prompt-based scoring for acceptability, relevance, distinctness, sufficiency

answer_4.quote: We evaluate trees using the metrics introduced in Section 3.2 (acceptability, relevance, and sufficiency) through three annotation tasks... we sample 200 proofs... and evaluate this set with human annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess correctness on a scale of 1-5 for leaf nodes, relevance for parent-child pairs, and distinctness and sufficiency for branching nodes.
